description: This is a Java class implementing the service layer for managing notes, including CRUD operations, interacting with repository and mapper classes.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service component for handling business logic related to notes, including CRUD operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from a request DTO and returns the response DTO.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves all notes as a list of response DTOs.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by its ID; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new data from request DTO.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, throws exception if not found.
